reason: The evidence confirms three approved standards but does not establish that they were the first three NIST post-quantum standards.
sourceEvidence: The Secretary of Commerce approved three standards in August 2024; no supplied source evidence identifies them as the first three.
synthesisStatement: FIPS 203, 204 and 205 were approved in August 2024.
narrativeStatement: The first three NIST post-quantum standards, approved by the Secretary of Commerce in August 2024, cover two functions.
materiality: Whether these were the first standards cannot be determined from the supplied evidence.
